code:
# 把非 3NF 模式用「合成法」拆成 3NF, 并用 sqlite 实跑验证信息可还原
import sqlite3


def closure(attrs, fds):
    res = set(attrs)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for lhs, rhs in fds:
            if lhs <= res and not rhs <= res:
                res |= rhs
                changed = True
    return res


def fmt(s):
    return "".join(sorted(s))


def synthesize(attrs, fds):
    """3NF 合成法: 最小覆盖 + 若某分片不含候选键则补一个候选键分片。"""
    sing = []
    for lhs, rhs in fds:
        for a in sorted(rhs):
            sing.append((frozenset(lhs), frozenset([a])))
    sing = sorted(set(sing), key=lambda f: (sorted(f[0]), sorted(f[1])))
    cur = list(sing)
    i = 0
    while i < len(cur):
        trial = cur[:i] + cur[i + 1:]
        if closure(cur[i][0], trial) >= set(cur[i][1]):
            cur = trial
        else:
            i += 1
    # 合并同左部的 FD
    merged = {}
    for lhs, rhs in cur:
        merged.setdefault(lhs, set()).update(rhs)
    pieces = [frozenset(lhs | frozenset(merged[lhs])) for lhs in sorted(merged, key=lambda s: sorted(s))]
    return pieces, cur


print("=== 非 3NF 模式 -> 3NF 合成与验证 ===")
attrs = {"Sno", "Sname", "Dept", "Dean"}
fds = [
    (frozenset(["Sno"]), frozenset(["Sname"])),
    (frozenset(["Sno"]), frozenset(["Dept"])),
    (frozenset(["Dept"]), frozenset(["Dean"])),
]
print("R = " + fmt(attrs))
print("F = " + ", ".join("%s->%s" % (fmt(l), fmt(r)) for l, r in fds))
print()
print("违反 3NF 的原因: Dept->Dean 中 Dept 不是超键, 且 Dean 不是主属性")
print()

pieces, mc = synthesize(attrs, fds)
print("最小覆盖: " + ", ".join("%s->%s" % (fmt(l), fmt(r)) for l, r in mc))
print("合成得到的分片:")
for p in pieces:
    print("  " + fmt(p))
print()

# 验证每个分片是否 BCNF
def is_bcnf(attrs_p, fds_p):
    lst = sorted(attrs_p)
    n = len(lst)
    supers = []
    for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
        sub = frozenset(lst[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1)
        if closure(sub, fds_p) == set(attrs_p):
            supers.append(sub)
    cands = [s for s in supers if not any(o < s for o in supers)]
    for lhs, rhs in fds_p:
        if rhs <= lhs:
            continue
        if closure(lhs, fds_p) != set(attrs_p):
            return False, cands
    return True, cands


print("分片范式等级:")
for p in pieces:
    local = [(l, r) for l, r in fds if set(l) | set(r) <= set(p)]
    b, cands = is_bcnf(p, local)
    print("  %-20s 局部FD=%-22s 候选键=%-8s BCNF=%s"
          % (fmt(p), ", ".join("%s->%s" % (fmt(l), fmt(r)) for l, r in local) or "无",
             "/".join(fmt(c) for c in cands), "YES" if b else "NO"))
print()

# ---- sqlite 实跑 ----
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE student (sno TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sname TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE dept_attr (sno TEXT PRIMARY KEY, dept TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE dept (dept TEXT PRIMARY KEY, dean TEXT NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO student VALUES ('S01','Zhang'),('S02','Li'),('S03','Wang');
INSERT INTO dept_attr VALUES ('S01','CS'),('S02','CS'),('S03','Math');
INSERT INTO dept VALUES ('CS','Prof_Chen'),('Math','Prof_Liu');
""")
print("原始(未分解)信息, 用 3 表 JOIN 还原:")
rows = cur.execute("""
SELECT s.sno, s.sname, d.dept, dd.dean
FROM student s
JOIN dept_attr d ON s.sno = d.sno
JOIN dept dd ON d.dept = dd.dept
ORDER BY s.sno
""").fetchall()
print("  %-5s %-7s %-6s %-10s" % ("sno", "sname", "dept", "dean"))
for r in rows:
    print("  %-5s %-7s %-6s %-10s" % r)
print("  行数 = %d" % len(rows))
print()

# 更新异常对照: 改系主任
cs_students = cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dept_attr WHERE dept='CS'").fetchone()[0]
cur.execute("UPDATE dept SET dean='Prof_Zhao' WHERE dept='CS'")
changed = cur.execute("SELECT changes()").fetchone()[0]
print("范式化后改 CS 系主任: dept 表只写 %d 行" % changed)
print("  若未分解(宽表): 需改 %d 行 (全部 CS 学生行), 且忘记同步就产生不一致" % cs_students)
print("  验证 JOIN 结果同步:")
for r in cur.execute("""
SELECT s.sno, s.sname, d.dept, dd.dean
FROM student s JOIN dept_attr d ON s.sno=d.sno JOIN dept dd ON d.dept=dd.dept
WHERE d.dept='CS' ORDER BY s.sno
""").fetchall():
    print("  " + " | ".join(str(x) for x in r))
con.close()
